notes.title: "Espionage" Demo Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Espionage Demo Update Now Live![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846677/e7c1edaf30cfa2430e79cd79b4c3af411a56dff1.png"]Dear Agents,
We're excited to announce a major update to the free playable demo of Espionage on Steam. This update incorporates valuable feedback from our community, delivering significant improvements and expansions to enhance your gameplay experience.
Key Updates:
Story & Narrative Overhaul:

Completely revamped plot progression, character dialogues, and cutscenes

Improved presentation of key story elements for clearer narrative flow and character motivations

Enhanced environmental storytelling for deeper immersion

Gameplay Optimizations & Fixes:

Performance Boost: Improved frame rates and stability

Refined Controls: Smoother movement, stealth mechanics, and interaction responsiveness

UI/UX Improvements: More intuitive interface and streamlined interactions

Bug Fixes: Addressed multiple issues affecting gameplay

Your Feedback Matters!
Try the updated demo and share your thoughts with us! Your input will help us further polish the game.

Wishlist Now! If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to add Espionage to your Steam wishlist!
Submit Feedback: Share your suggestions via \[Xiaohongshu] or \[Bilibili] (Search "Espionage").

Thank you for supporting Espionage! Ready to step into the shadows?

— The Espionage Development Team

notes.title: Beijing Fusion, here we come!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This time we will be attending the 2024 Fusion Games Festival in Beijing this month.
Open the world's first offline trial with a brand new demo!

Beijing Station intelligence sharing
◆ Exhibition time: September 21 - September 22, 2024
◆ Pavilion Address: Beijing Beiren Yichuang International Convention and Exhibition Center

Welcome to D13, try our games, have face-to-face communication, and give us valuable comments ~ ~
